About the Platform

Empowering Civil Engineers to Crack GATE with Precision & Consistency

GATE Civil Tracker was engineered to solve one critical problem: managing the vast, complex GATE Civil Engineering syllabus without falling into spreadsheet chaos or losing study momentum.

Why We Built This

Preparing for GATE Civil Engineering involves 9 multifaceted subjects spanning over 60 granular topics — from Soil Mechanics and Environmental Engineering to Hydrology, Steel Structures, and Transportation.

Standard spreadsheets lack dynamic progress weighting, PYQ year tracking, and mock test reflection loops. GATE Civil Tracker integrates these into a unified, interactive workspace.

Privacy & Local-First Freedom

Your preparation data belongs solely to you. There are no mandatory sign-ups, no cloud databases tracking your mock test scores, and zero paywalls.

All your progress is securely stored inside your browser's local storage, with one-click JSON export and import capabilities to backup or switch devices instantly.

Key Architecture & Features

01 Weighted Syllabus Engine

Evaluates overall readiness based on the historical mark distribution of GATE CE papers, ensuring you prioritize high-yield subjects.

02 Granular PYQ Tracker

Log year-by-year past questions with optional topic selection, recording study hours and specific concepts needing reinforcement.

03 Mock Test Analyzer

Record test series scores, percentiles, and mistake notes. Identify recurring errors before sitting for the real examination.

04 3-Stage Revision Engine

Beat the forgetting curve through systematically enforced 1st, 2nd, and Final revision stages across every subject.

05 Gamified XP & Badges

Stay motivated with 110 unique unlockable achievements, daily study streaks, and rank leveling systems that celebrate small wins.

06 Astro + Tailwind v4 Speed

Instant static load times, smooth view transitions, and zero layout shift on desktop, tablet, and mobile smartphones.
